abstract: An immunohistologic study of germ cell tumors of the ovary was undertaken to investigate a correlation of the histology with the presence of alpha-fetoprotein (AFP), human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG), and carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA) in the tissue specimens. A positive reaction for AFP was consisted of dark brownblack granular intracytoplasmic deposits and some of hyaline globules were also positive in some instances. There was tissue localization of AFP in 9 of 10 embryonal carcinomas (endodermal sinus tumor, Teilum) and in 4 of 5 solid teratomas. Two patients with embryonal carcinoma positive for AFP had normal serum level in AFP. A positive staining for HCG was found in 4 embryonal carcinomas and in 2 solid teratomas; it was consisted of dark brown cytoplasmic deposits localized exclusively to syncytiotrophoblast giant cells. The tumor cells positive for AFP but negative for HCG, and vice vasa indicated that these two carcinoembryonic proteins were produced by different cells. The localization of CEA was also studied in 3 embryonal carcinomas. None of embryonal carcinomas and 3 solid teratomas were reacted to CEA; it was consisted of a dark brown deposit localized in cell surface of stratified squamous cells and tall columnar cells forming glandular structure. All of the histologically immature neural components were negative for these carcinoembryonic proteins.
abstract_ja: 卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍について免疫組織学的検討を行い、組織像と組織内のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)、CEAの存在との相関を調べた。AFPの陽性反応は、暗褐色～黒色の顆粒状細胞質内沈着として認められ、硝子様小体の一部も陽性となる場合があった。AFPの組織局在は、胎児性癌（卵黄嚢腫瘍、Teilum）10例中9例、充実性奇形腫5例中4例で認められた。AFP陽性の胎児性癌患者2例では血清AFP値は正常であった。hCGの陽性染色は胎児性癌4例、充実性奇形腫2例で認められ、合胞体栄養膜巨細胞に限局した暗褐色の細胞質内沈着として観察された。AFP陽性・hCG陰性の腫瘍細胞、およびその逆のパターンは、これら2種類の癌胎児性タンパク質が異なる細胞によって産生されることを示していた。CEAの局在も胎児性癌3例で検討したが、胎児性癌のいずれおよび充実性奇形腫3例でもCEAに反応しなかった。CEAは、重層扁平上皮細胞および腺構造を形成する高円柱状細胞の細胞表面に暗褐色の沈着として局在していた。組織学的に未熟な神経成分は、いずれもこれらの癌胎児性タンパク質に陰性であった。
